name: web1-personal-site
description: Ivan's Little Web — статичный сайт в эстетике Web 1.0

scripts.build:ts: npm run lint:ts && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('public/js', { recursive: true, force: true })" && esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --minify --target=es2020 --charset=utf8 --outfile=public/js/main.js
scripts.lint: npm run format:check && npm run lint:css && npm run lint:ts && npm run lint:go && npm run size
scripts.fix: npm run format && npm run lint:css:fix
scripts.api:gen: go test ./server/internal/api/tests -run TestSpecFresh -update && npm run api:types
